records.message: fix: config precedence now correctly allows local config to override remote (#7141)
records.changed_behavior: Remote/well-known config became the base layer so local/global/custom/project/inline config can override it.
records.previous_behavior: Remote config was merged after local config and could incorrectly override local intent.
records.new_behavior: Remote config is loaded first as the lowest-precedence base; local layers override it.

records.message: core: preserve permission config key order to maintain user-defined permission precedence
records.changed_behavior: Permission config parsing now preserves user-declared key order.
records.previous_behavior: Schema parsing could reorder permission keys and therefore alter precedence.
records.new_behavior: Original key order is captured and reconstructed so last-matching-rule semantics remain user-defined.

records.changed_behavior: AGENTS.md from OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR is checked before the ordinary global config AGENTS.md.
records.previous_behavior: The ordinary global config AGENTS.md could win before the custom config directory source.
records.new_behavior: The custom config directory AGENTS.md wins when present, with ordinary global AGENTS.md as fallback.
